compute.cost_note: stdlib only (lexicon matching); no spaCy, no API costs

do_not_use_when: the register legitimately requires a posture (deontic policy prose, evidential academic prose); compare against a register-matched baseline
you want an AI/human verdict; marker lists and bands are heuristic

examples.description: Stance posture against a personal baseline

purpose: Typed stance and modality audit. Counts deontic and epistemic modals, hedges, boosters, evidentials, first-person stance and refusal markers per 1,000 words, with a provisional band over posture-shift signals (hedge-booster oscillation, booster dominance, refusal absence, first-person collapse) and optional per-category baseline z-scores.
use_when: checking whether editing shifted the writer's epistemic posture (more boosters, fewer hedges or refusals)
comparing a draft's stance profile against the writer's own baseline (--baseline-dir)
